_comment: All tunables live here. Secrets live in .env only. Thresholds are SPEC v0.2 priors and stay FROZEN inside a tuning window.

birdeye._daily_cu_cap_comment: null = derived from plan (monthly/30 * 0.9 = 240k/day on Starter). Was 3000 during free-tier dev.

stage0._comment: filters are Birdeye token_list_v3 params passed verbatim; re-verified client-side

stage1._comment: short mode. CALIBRATED ONCE 2026-09-08 on 0.32h of stored rows (SPEC s14): rvol_1m is a RECENCY check (>=1.5), rvol_5m is the ignition gate; page-percentile gates disabled (page mixes mcap tiers). FROZEN.

stage0._comment: Robinhood list v3 has no 1m/5m/30m fields and holder is always null (T2) - filter/sort on 1h windows, no holder filter

stage1._comment: hourly mode. CALIBRATED ONCE 2026-09-08 (SPEC s14): igniters ENTER the page so most have no previous poll; fallback tightened. Coarse pre-filter only - real RH ignition comes from the trade tape (T5/T6). FROZEN.

candidates._comment: T8 candidate manager (SPEC s10 hysteresis). Enter on the Stage-1 trigger; stay on weaker conditions; cap with weakest-oldest eviction; hard veto removes + cooldown; silence expires; daily cap degrades to WATCH-only.

alerts._comment: T13 delivery policy (cooldowns, caps, channels). Tier thresholds live under scoring.

labeler._comment: close pass: scan_rows (free) -> multi_price (Lite+). path pass: one OHLCV 1m call at the final horizon per NOMINATION (45 CU) fills MFE/MAE for all horizons. Controls get close-based labels only.

tape._comment: Stage-2 trade tape (txs v3, 12 CU/page of 100). Polls the active candidate set; T8 owns the real set, until then the runner uses WATCH nominations from the last candidates.max_stay_min. Budgeted: the tape is the most expensive stream.

features._comment: Trade-based features (SPEC s11). Windows are trade counts with a max age; anchor = first 20-trade window whose USD rate >= mult x trailing rate (baseline excludes the window) with >= m distinct buyers, searched within lookback.

wash._comment: Wash/bot composite + vetoes (SPEC s5B, s10). Components normalised lo->hi to 0..1 then weighted. Vetoes always win.

enrichment._comment: Optional per-candidate Birdeye enrichments (Starter). holdings: top_traders 25 CU once per candidate (5-min cache) for the DISTRIBUTION veto. tag_flows: wallet-tags-tracker 30 CU, Solana only, once per candidate.

scoring._comment: T9 (SPEC s10). score = participation 30 + orderflow 25 + efficiency 15 + structure 15 + holder_growth 10 + safety 5. Vetoes always win. Eligibility window in seconds after the anchor (tape onset, else Stage-1 nomination time); widened from [30,90] to [30,180] because the tape polls every 60 s. FROZEN priors.
